# A blank line in a program is written as an empty line, not as a line that
# holds only the indentation of the program.
celfmt -agent -i src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

celfmt -agent -i want.txt
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --
interval: {{interval}}
program: |-
  // c1

  state.with({"events":[],"want_more":false})
tags:
  - forwarded
-- want.txt --
interval: {{interval}}
program: |-
  // c1

  state.with({"events": [], "want_more": false})
tags:
  - forwarded
